ding the serme eir a Bragt of Pensylia in let tu lalte was sech and euth le cerent, nine miles aul-t bes cemp. $ leat the same dug. fami him ei an almert djing centeliv ane legegen At he hesent te hen, he uns take stutt aftin wian antuleneseptin deny his illness te presen leke air all the mere robable fren the fameshu affenne alich lu presents - 9am occus-
ame apu lus asseml lus cenditin eas far ti de met deflate - he had benaltocki astel te flest cp ale pants of the lout, alch restat hard upm abetin cas senter lin back deange couse open perfecty black an unfolli out: his beet, had assum the sene affense tea tongo his stuckings had neve been semes durg all his illness and hes tues were malled and gren logett and are nore dropp in cntellep mediese a nes seem - meno fun li city le serdicta sendue peresting fu cant of morerestment, huhue too afem a fever bus- 5 frie to hunge ane starsaleir are tus destinet cenditeins - he can he ent, en luo face enth his enstefs fro ap with hai pills to present his to press. tunehng Ma beet (fur with he kie engended ly fort & coe, sensatir ei selem do thun) ane ciste only fu semetting du cat" foot lotto & sents ann a little meat coe le eats tree of tus lass one de le amputates todig-The auregan of the breye cever de see lin, hat-hod as idea of lus centili
